 'Star Wars' will celebrate 50 years in 2027: What to know and what to shop 
 3:35 'Star Wars' celebrates 50 years in 2027 Lucasfilm Ltd. By Claire Peltier November 12, 2026, 1:42 PM 
 "Star Wars" is turning 50.
 Beginning Jan. 1, 2027, " Star Wars " will celebrate 50 years with new projects, fan events, archival releases, anniversary merchandise and the theatrical re-release of the original 1977 film.
 Related Articles
 The best 'Star Wars' gifts for fans of all ages, from toys and collectibles to clothing and more
 In 2027, fans of the franchise will be able to shop new collectibles, toys, apparel and beyond, including seven new exclusive LEGO sets like the LEGO Star Wars Up-Scaled Luke Skywalker and the LEGO Star Wars A New Hope Movie Poster.
 50th anniversary of Star Wars. Lucasfilm Ltd. Hasbro will drop collectible figures, including Luke Skywalker, Princess Leia and R2-D2, plus a vintage collection.
 50th anniversary of Star Wars. Lucasfilm Ltd. Adidas has revealed a collection of footwear and apparel and Mars snack brands will celebrate with themed treats.
 Can't wait? Below, shop some of our favorite " Star Wars " finds and be sure to check back in January when the anniversary celebrations begin.
